name: video_frames
description: Extract still images from a video so you can look at it. Modes: count (N frames spread evenly, default 6), interval (one frame every N seconds), timestamps (frames at exact times) or contact_sheet (one grid image of N frames with time labels, the cheapest way to see a whole video). Images are attached to the result when the model supports vision, and saved in the workspace.

input.description: Path of the video file, relative to the workspace.

count.description: Number of frames for count and contact_sheet (1–100). Default 6, or 12 for a contact sheet.

interval.description: For mode interval: seconds between frames, e.g. "10".

timestamps.description: For mode timestamps: the times to capture. Time as seconds ("90", "12.5") or clock time ("1:30", "01:02:03.5").

width.description: Width of each frame in pixels (height keeps the aspect ratio). Default 640, or 320 in a contact sheet.

columns.description: Columns in a contact sheet. Default: a square-ish grid.

labels.description: Stamp the time on each frame. Default true for contact sheets, false otherwise.

output_dir.description: Folder for the frames, relative to the workspace. Default <name>_frames next to the video.

attach.description: Attach the images to the result for vision models. Default true.
